meta.name: story-deslop
meta.description: 网文去AI味。检测并清除文本中的AI写作痕迹，让文字回归自然、非模板化。触发方式：/story-deslop、/去AI味、「去AI味」「这篇太AI了」「网文去AI味」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 改写网文,清除AI腔调,让文字自然如人写
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你写网文怕被看出AI痕迹,想让文字更自然、有温度
copy.tagline_en: Rewrite web fiction to remove AI-flavored writing and restore a natural human tone
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write web fiction and want to remove AI traces for a more natural voice

howto.what: 把网文里“太AI”的写法规整回自然：检测AI味并分级，再按禁用词、句式、心理描写等检查项逐项改写，输出检测报告与润色后的文本，保留剧情只动表达。
howto.when: 当你说出“去AI味”“这篇太AI了”等触发词，或使用 /story-deslop 等命令时触发。

say.text: 这段太AI了，帮我改自然点。
say.note: 会先做AI味扫描再逐句润色。

say.text: 先检查这几段有没有AI味，别改。
say.note: 只出检测报告，不动原文。
按文件模式扫描并落盘修改。

howto.what_en: Detects AI-flavored patterns in web-novel text, grades the flavor level, and rewrites the writing to read more natural and human—keeping plot and character intent, only changing expression. Outputs a detection report and the polished text.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says phrases like "去AI味" or "这篇太AI了", or uses the /story-deslop command.

say_en.text: This passage feels too AI-written. Make it more natural.
say_en.note: It scans for AI patterns, then polishes sentence by sentence.

say_en.text: Check these paragraphs for AI flavor, but don't change them.
say_en.note: Only a report is returned; the original text stays untouched.
File mode: scans and writes changes to disk.
